The riding that didn't move — and flipped anyway

Every poll, 2021 → 2025

Aaron Gunn's Conservative share rose barely two points on this map. What flipped the seat was on the other side of the ledger: a Liberal wave through an NDP electorate.

Poll estimates fold each advance-poll district's votes into its component polling divisions (party-proportional to election day) and scale mail/special ballots riding-wide, so every vote in the count is on this map. 2021 baselines are blended onto 2025 boundaries by geographic overlap — the blend reproduces Elections Canada's official transposition within half a point per party. Comox Valley polls (tagged ‡) compare against 2021 results from Courtenay–Alberni.

Sources: Elections Canada official poll-by-poll results (44th & 45th GE) and polling-division boundary files (2021, 2025); EC transposition of 2021 results to the 2023 Representation Order. Estimates by McAllister Research. Area does not indicate voters.
